# CANDIDATE: VIX_CONDITION_RELAXATION_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup misses two of three J winner days (4/29 and 5/01) due to an overly strict VIX confirmation filter requiring VIX ≥ 20 or rising. On these days, VIX was likely between 15-20, causing valid bearish rejection setups to be blocked. Relaxing the VIX threshold to ≥ 15 (or rising) should capture these missing winners while maintaining discipline on loser days by preserving other structural filters (level rejection, ribbon flip, confluence).

## Mechanism

Change the parameter `j_bearish_rejection_vix_min` from 20 to 15 in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup's context filters. All other trigger conditions (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence with multi-day/premarket structure) remain unchanged. Entry, stop, and target logic per the playbook stays identical. This is a pure filter relaxation to increase sensitivity on valid bearish rejection days without altering entry timing or exit management.
